name: hero-title-screen
description: The title screen of a retro-styled putting video game: a clean putting green under a bright sky, a golf ball resting near the cup, and the game's logo treatment. Confident, inviting, holiday-release energy.

name: feature-read-the-green
description: An overhead view of a putting green with a curved putting line drawn from the ball to the cup, showing the slope and break. Focused and strategic.

name: feature-choose-club
description: A golfer selecting a putter from the bag and lining up their stance over the ball, clubs visible in the bag beside them. Deliberate and calm.

name: feature-set-power
description: A game-style power meter set mid-swing beside a ball on the green, the ball beginning to roll toward the hole. A sense of controlled momentum.

name: about-lining-up-putt
description: A player crouched behind the ball on the green, lining up a putt with the cup in the distance. Just the golfer and the line to the hole, quiet concentration.

name: about-step-up
description: A golfer standing over the ball at the start of a hole, the cup in sight and the slope laid out ahead. The beginning of a putt.

name: about-take-putt
description: A golfer mid-stroke sending a putt toward the cup, a steady hand and a good read, the ball tracking along the line.

name: about-ball-drops
description: A close-up of a golf ball dropping into the cup on a manicured green, the successful end of a putt. Satisfying and clean.
